label: Walk To
description: Character or camera navigates to a target position or object.

label: Inspect
description: Display detail metadata for the target object or character.

label: Talk
description: Open a dialogue interaction with a character.

label: Observe
description: Passive camera focus on a target without initiating dialogue.

label: Meeting
description: Gather multiple characters at a shared meeting location.

label: Working
description: Character enters its working animation/state at a workstation.

label: Emergency
description: Character or room enters emergency-state visualization.

label: Notification
description: Surface a notification badge or alert tied to the target.
